parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no documented border/ID-marker friction (axis unassessed — an open question, light weight), and no documented violence record; in a well-documented jurisdiction that silence is mildly positive. Society is reserved rather than hostile, with little direct friction in tourist areas. Judicial climate is favourable (2023 top-court bathroom ruling and sterilisation-strike-down), but that is resident-facing climate, and no statute gives a visitor any discrimination- or violence-protection remedy. The real exposures are institutional: gender-segregated bathing (onsen/sento) documented as a genuine difficulty with only venue-level workarounds, and custody placement by family register with documented mockery, delayed hormones and cross-sex housing — tier-1 when triggered, but conditional on arrest rather than universal. Friction and open questions, no unremedied universal ban: a step below the acceptance-with-working-protections tier.
